integrity: The result and equality family are proved by explicit algebraic identities; finite symbolic checks supplement but do not replace the universal analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the functional (1,1,0) on polynomials of degree at most two is addressed; no assertion for other degrees.
Classical work on arbitrary coefficient functionals is not exhaustively reviewed; a specific early article and thesis have only bibliographic coverage.
title: Exact quadratic Shapiro coefficient-sum norm and rigidity
